verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance automation platform, so per-employee workstation compliance tracking is a fair question for it. However, the pack has no evidence of an endpoint agent or of device checks for disk encryption, screen lock or password managers. The only related item is a bare 'JumpCloud Integration' doc title, which does not show that device posture is collected per employee. Generic 'continuous monitoring' claims do not establish this specific capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration
